bullets: Maximum Strength and Grip: Our glass bottles feature a removable silicone base that protects against impacts and prevents sliding on wet surfaces. Goodbye to accidental breakages!

descripcion_html: <p>2 x 500 ml Glass Sprayers with removable silicone base and pump with 2 spray modes. </p><p>Applicable scene: </p><ul><li>Ideal for spraying any type of water or oil based liquid. </li><li>Perfect for cleaning, gardening and pet care. </li></ul><p>2 Spray Modes: By rotating the spray nozzle, you can switch between concentrated or diffuse atomization mode, adapting to your specific needs. </p><p>DURABLE: Its silicone base provides great adhesion to surfaces, even wet, preventing impact breaks and accidental drops. </p><p>Does not leak: Unlike other glass sprayers, the head has a gasket that fits perfectly into the neck of the bottle, preventing any kind of dripping. </p><p>Presentation: The product arrives in an elegant box with safe sprayers inside a foam moulding for optimal protection during transport. </p><p>STYLISH AND FUNCTIONAL - In addition to their practicality, these sprayers add a touch of sophistication to any workspace or home. </p>
